observation_summary: A NullPointerException is thrown instead of the expected AssertionError when using the 'same(null)' matcher.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the 'Same' matcher attempts to call the 'toString()' method on the 'wanted' object without checking if it is null. When 'same(null)' is used in a verification, the 'wanted' field is null, leading to a NullPointerException during the description generation phase of the assertion failure. The fix adds a null check to ensure that 'null' is printed as a string instead of invoking a method on a null reference.
